title: Chapter 413: The Four Heavenly Demons
content:
Chapter 413: The Four Heavenly Demons

The two of them were Yueming and Jing, who was directly sent to the Chaos Realm by Lu Daosheng.

After coming to the Chaos Realm, the two of them did meet Lu Xue as they wished, and they stayed with Lu Xue in the Desolate City and the Human Emperor Palace for a long time.

Until later, Lu Xue wanted to leave the Chaos Realm, she left the two in the deserted city.

After so many years, Yueming has long lost his original immaturity and seems more mature and stable.

Only as the source of disaster, there is no change, and it still looks cute.

Hearing Jing's words, Yueming sighed softly, reached out to stroke Jing's little head, and said, "Sister Xue is so busy, how can you have time to play with you?"

"But I really want to tell Sister Xue about the matter here."

Speaking of this, Yueming's eyes suddenly appeared. Since he stayed in the deserted city for a while, his strength has been greatly improved.

But he knew that this was far from avenging senior Yue Shi Shen.

So many years have passed, where has Senior Lu gone and why hasn’t he come back yet?

Standing there, Yueming was silent for a long time, and finally pulled Jing away from the border and headed towards the direction of the deserted city.

.........

I don't know how long it took.

In the Tiande Clan, Lu Xue and his group traveled through mountains and rivers, sometimes stopping and sometimes moving quickly, and finally arrived.

"Who are you waiting for? Do you know where this place is?!"

Several huge monsters with deep breath surrounded Lu Xue and his group, with fierce momentum.

As can be seen from the naked eye, the confidence of the Heavenly Demon Clan has become deeper.

If you find a human race who can come to the core area of the Heavenly Demon Clan, you will definitely ask patiently. After all, the human race is powerful and they cannot afford to offend it.

But now it's different.

Dozens of ancestor-level dragon seniors in the clan are in charge. It is no exaggeration to say that even if they meet the Human Emperor Palace, they are not worth it.

Unless you meet someone from the deserted city.

However, Huangcheng almost stayed in his arms and ignored the world, how could they be encountered by them?

Therefore, when they saw Lu Xue and his group, they didn't take it seriously at all.

Just as the leader of the monster wanted to continue saying something, Ao Qing suddenly rushed out and came to the eyes of the monsters.

Immediately afterwards, Ao Qing cursed at the demons in front of him.

"Did your fucking eyes grow on your butts? I don't even recognize me?!"

At the same time, a supreme aura of the Heavenly Demon surged out of Ao Qing's body.

In an instant, the entire Tiande Clan was shocked.

The big monster surrounding Ao Qing was instantly pressed by this terrifying blood force and fell to the ground, unable to move.

They had fear in their eyes and wanted to explain, but they couldn't speak at this moment.

Within the Tiande Clan, the head of the Tiande Clan was warmly greeting the Dragon Clan in the Huangcheng, and was still thinking about when Lord Ao Qing would arrive.

But suddenly, a terrifying blood force pulled him back from his thoughts.

"What, what's going on?"

But the dragons in the deserted city were very happy.

"Hahaha, Lord Longzi is here!"

"Follow me to welcome Lord Aoqing right away!"

The dragons were filled with joy and rushed outwards.

At this time, the leader of the Tian Yao clan reacted instantly.

"Hurry, welcome Lord Aoqing, Lord Aoqing is here!"

The entire core area of the Tian Yao Clan is a huge stone city. It seems to be formed naturally, and it is filled with wild aura everywhere.

Of course, compared to the deserted city, it is a bit worth mentioning.

However, before the stone giant gate was opened, dozens of giant dragons rushed out of the stone city.

"Lord Longzi!"

The dragons respectfully saluted Ao Qing.

At this time, the leader of the Tiandemon Clan and the powerful Tiandemon Clan hurried out.

This time, none of the powerful people in the Heavenly Demon Clan had a slim eye and met Ao Qing one after another.

Even though Ao Qing shrank and was just that big, they still recognized it at a glance.

"We'll pay homage to Lord Aoqing!"

Seeing that the demons worshiped and surrendered, Ao Qing's nostrils were almost lifted to the sky, and the corners of his mouth were harder to press than AK.

Just as he was quietly enjoying this dazzling moment, one hand suddenly pulled his tail from behind.

"Xiaoqing, that's about the same."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ao Qing coughed lightly and nodded expressionlessly.

Bai Ling beside Lu Xue looked at everything in front of her, and the worship in her eyes was almost about to turn into reality.

So this is the power of Lord Ao Qing?

If she was not mistaken, this is the core area of the Tian Yao Clan, Tian Yao City. Therefore, the big monsters in front of her are all senior figures of the Tian Yao Clan.

What kind of existence do you follow?

Immediately afterwards, Bai Ling was surrounded by powerful demons and entered the city.

Along the way, Bai Ling seemed to be dreaming.

The monsters around him kept greeting him. If he had been wandering around with his brother in the past, he would have been respectful to see these monsters.

But now, everything has changed.

And all of this is because of Lord Ao Qing and Senior Lu Xue.

Who is Senior Lu Xue? How could she let someone like Lord Ao Qing follow him?

The seed of doubt was planted in his heart, but at this moment the monsters around him suddenly realized that Bai Ling's body was actually a Vermilion Bird.

One of the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon!

"Clan leader, you have made a major discovery."

A big demon quietly sent a voice to the leader of the Tiande Clan.

At this time, the head of the Tian Yao tribe was following Ao Qing with a flattering smile. When he heard the voice, his face remained unchanged, and at the same time he responded with a voice transmission: "What's the matter?"

"That little girl is the Vermilion Bird of the Four Elephants of the Heavenly Demon."

"What?!"

The head of the Tian Yao clan was shocked, and even the smile on his face stiffened for a moment.

There is a legend in the Tiande Clan that is in the same era. If the four symbols of Tiandemon can be collected, the purest Tiandemon bloodline can be stimulated. At the same time, it means that the Tiandemon Clan will enter the glory. time.

A long time ago, the Heavenly Demon Clan gathered all the four heavenly demons, and the Heavenly Demon Clan suddenly increased its strength and overwhelmed the Chaos Realm clans.

In this era, Xuanwu and Qinglong appeared in the younger generation of the clan, and the patriarch of the Tian Yao clan had no thoughts about this.

After all, there are often times when two heavenly demons and four symbols appear in one era in the Heavenly Demon Clan.

But now, another Suzaku was found.

In other words, the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon are only left to the White Tiger to gather.

There is hope!

"Don't make a statement for now, observe it in secret."

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan suppressed the joy in his heart and entered the Tian Yao City with Ao Qing, Lu Xue and the old man Broken Sword.

As soon as he entered the Tiande Clan, Lu Xue, under the gaze of the demons, said, "I will introduce myself. My name is Lu Xue, the first master of the Human Emperor Palace."

"Captain of the Heavenly Demon Clan, I want to ask you, how do you view the human race now?"
